resources.string:
dEdx and libdEdx are developed by the Aarhus Particle Therapy Group with support from the Danish Cancer Society.

libdEdx was written by Jakob Toftegaard and Niels Bassler at the Dept. of Physics and Astronomy and Dept. of Experimental Clinical Oncology with support from Armin Lühr, Helge Knudsen and David C. Hansen.
We do not claim any correctness of the produced results, any use of these data are at own risk.

The app was originally developed by Casper Christensen as a student project at Aarhus University.
